dataset.name: RhlA combinatorial protein fitness landscape
dataset.selection_reason: Untouched in NABU repository history; public clean combinatorial dataset with genotype, mutation count, and fitness fields.
dataset.objective: RhlA overall enzyme activity only; selectivity and specific-activity phenotypes are excluded.
dataset.dataset_scope_note: CombinGym RhlA contains measured single, double, and triple mutants across a sparse multi-site mutational space.

candidate_scope.reason: Measure sample efficiency for predicting/designing unseen triple mutants from a nested subset of all available single/double/triple measurements.

fixed_hidden_test.rule: candidate mutation_count == 3 AND FNV1a32(candidate_id) mod 10 in {7,8,9}
fixed_hidden_test.lower_order_rows_in_hidden_hash_buckets: excluded from evaluation and never used as training labels

training_pool.rule: mutation_count in {1,2,3} AND FNV1a32(candidate_id) mod 10 in {0,1,2,3,4,5,6}

budgets.selection: For each p, take the first ceil(p/100 * total eligible 1-3 mutant rows) rows from the deterministic training-pool ordering.

fixed_candidate_pool.definition: Intersection of hidden triple-mutant candidates scoreable by every frozen budget model; computed before truth reveal.

architecture.name: NABU V8.3 Dual-Objective Router
architecture.global_gate: if visible OOF B4 Spearman > B3 OOF Spearman, use global B5
architecture.elite_gate: otherwise allow rank-preserving B5 rerank inside frozen B3 top-20% only if visible OOF elite Top-50 mean percentile improves and Top-1%-hit count does not decrease

primary_metrics_per_budget: Top-50 count of true hidden Top-1% variants

practical_threshold_vs_40pct_reference.definition: smallest budget satisfying all criteria below against the frozen 40% V8.3 reference

router_safety_check.per_budget: V8.3 must be compared against the same-budget B3 baseline on every primary metric.
router_safety_check.purpose: measure whether adaptive routing adds value or protects the pairwise backbone as data availability changes.

anti_leakage.stage_0: package deterministic training-pool labels, hidden triple identities, and separate sealed hidden triple truth; lower-order rows assigned to hidden hash buckets remain unused
anti_leakage.stage_A: construct all four nested budgets from training-pool identities only, fit frozen V8.3 independently at each budget, freeze a common scoreable hidden-triple pool, predictions, candidates, router decisions and hashes, then exit
anti_leakage.stage_B: verify every Stage-A hash before loading sealed hidden truth once and evaluating every frozen budget
